title: Python Basics 1
subtitle: From absolute zero, every line explained
desc: For complete beginners. Assumes no prior programming knowledge — every concept starts from what problem it solves, with runnable examples and instant exercises.

title: Python Basics 2
subtitle: Data structures and functions
desc: Lists, tuples, dicts, sets — how to use them and when to pick which. Function arguments, scope, recursion.

title: Python Basics 3
subtitle: Files, exceptions, modules & OOP
desc: Reading and writing files, catching errors, organising modules, and a complete mental model of classes and objects.

title: Essentials · Learn
subtitle: The whole language in two days
desc: For those who have learned once and need to pick it back up fast. Main trunk only, no warm-up.

title: Essentials · Drill
subtitle: Nail the basics with exercises
desc: No re-teaching. Fully exercise-driven — sweep away every common trap of the fundamentals stage in one pass.

title: Python Data Analysis 1
subtitle: NumPy and array thinking
desc: Switching your brain from Python lists to ndarray: vectorisation, broadcasting, indexing tricks.

title: Python Data Analysis 2
subtitle: pandas and tabular data
desc: The full DataFrame toolkit: cleaning, grouping, merging, time series.

title: Python Data Analysis 3
subtitle: Visualisation and practice
desc: Charting with matplotlib / seaborn, plus one end-to-end real-world analysis project.

title: Python Desktop 1
subtitle: tkinter fundamentals
desc: Windows, widgets, layouts, event binding — build your first usable desktop app.

title: Python Desktop 2
subtitle: Advanced tkinter & pygame
desc: Menus, dialogs, Canvas drawing; pygame's game loop and sprites.

title: Python Desktop 3
subtitle: A complete desktop project
desc: Build a practical tool with data storage — from requirements all the way to packaging and release.

title: Python Desktop Advanced 1
subtitle: PyQt / PySide core
desc: Signals and slots, layout management, common widgets, style sheets — the Qt mental model.

title: Python Desktop Advanced 2
subtitle: Qt advanced topics & shipping
desc: Model/view, threading, custom widgets, i18n, and packaging into an installer.

title: Python Engineering Practice
subtitle: From working code to shippable code
desc: Virtual environments, project layout, Git collaboration, unit testing, logging, packaging.

title: Python Algorithms 1
subtitle: Complexity, arrays & strings
desc: Starts with how to measure speed: time and space complexity. Then arrays and strings — the two most-tested foundations. Every exercise is really executed and graded in the page.

title: Python Algorithms 2
subtitle: Linked lists, stacks, queues, hashing & recursion
desc: The next layer of data structures: linked lists, stacks, queues, hash tables, plus recursion — the one idea that unlocks everything else once it clicks.

title: Python Algorithms 3
subtitle: Trees, graphs, sorting & DP
desc: The main battlefield: binary trees and heaps, graph traversal, the ten classic sorts, and the walk from brute force to an optimised DP solution.
